description: List where Follow On Tours goes and what it sells there. When a country has a tour on sale (`onSale`, with its link and dates), lead with that tour, then offer to build a trip around the traveller (`buildYourOwn`); a country with nothing on sale is built to order. Returns the sport hubs (cricket, golf, rugby, playing tours) in `sportHubs`, every live country page with its sport pages (cricket, golf, rugby, polo, playing tours and more) in `countries`, and the cricket grounds each cricket trip is built around in `destinations`. Apart from the tours in `onSale`, everything here is built to order, so no price or departure date applies: use list_tours for prices and details of what is on sale or quoted on request, and list_golf_trips for golf. Use this when asked where Follow On Tours goes, or whether they cover a sport, a country or a ground.
name: list_destinations
title: Where we go
